instruction: Enable the auto-save feature in LibreOffice Impress with a 10-minute interval.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling auto-save functionality (Tools > Options > Load/Save > General > Save AutoRecovery information every). Evaluator verifies AutoSave is enabled in configuration.
metadata.verification_method: Configuration file structure verified by reading existing check_presenter_console_disable function and LibreOffice registry XML schema

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: Incomplete verification - Instruction requires enabling auto-save WITH a 10-minute interval, but evaluator only checks if AutoSave is enabled (true/false). The 10-minute interval requirement is completely missing from the verification.
Missing verification: The evaluator should also check the AutoSaveTimeIntervall setting (or similar) to verify the interval is set to 10 minutes, not just that auto-save is enabled.
Coverage gap: The instruction has TWO requirements (enable auto-save + 10-minute interval) but the evaluator only checks ONE requirement (enable auto-save).

Semantic inconsistency: XPath points to '/org.openoffice.Office.Common/Save/Document' (Common settings shared across all LibreOffice apps) rather than Impress-specific settings, though this may be correct if the setting is indeed in the Common section.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add a second rule to verify the AutoSaveTimeIntervall setting equals 10 (or 600000 milliseconds, depending on the actual setting format in LibreOffice config)
Update the evaluator to use a multi-check approach: both AutoSave=true AND AutoSaveTimeIntervall=10
Verify the correct setting name and format for the auto-save interval in LibreOffice's registrymodifications.xcu file
Consider using partial credit scoring: 0.5 if AutoSave is enabled but interval is wrong, 1.0 if both are correct
